# Exact Sciences

[Woman relaxing at sunset.]
Introducing

## Cancerguard^{®}

Our innovative multi-cancer early detection test.
We're united by a shared purpose: helping people live fuller lives through better health. Together,
we will transform the way cancer is detected, diagnosed and managed for more people around the
world.
[Exact Sciences is now ABBOTT.]
[Lab technician examining a test sample on a microscope slide.]
We’re fighting cancer every step of the way
[A smiling patient hugging a caregiver.]
So that everyone feels confident about their path forward

## ## We help bring clarity to cancer

Cancer creates so many uncertainties. We’re committed to answering questions, solving problems, and
making a lasting, positive impact on people's lives. Our tests explore hereditary risks, screen for
cancer’s presence, and examine the unique genomic alterations of an individual’s cancer after a
diagnosis to help guide their treatment.

## Everything starts with people

We’re focused on patients, providers, doctors, researchers, and caregivers. Our medical experts
partner with the industry’s best minds and collaborate with top institutions, advocacy partners, and
policymakers to help change lives and transform how the world approaches cancer.
[A woman named Deepa smiling.]

## A breast cancer surgeon's breast cancer journey

Hear how genomic testing helped Deepa and her doctor make an informed decision to forgo
chemotherapy.^{[*][15]}
[oncotype DX Breast Recurrence Score logo.]
[A woman named Leigh Anne smiling.]

## Convenient testing made early detection easy

Watch how testing at home helped Leigh Anne take the first step in diagnosing and treating her colon
cancer before it progressed.
[Cologuard by Exact Sciences logo.]
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Fueling breakthroughs in cancer care

Our experience and process set us apart. Life-changing science. Deep expertise. Strong
collaboration. State-of-the-art labs. Rigorous research. The result? Proven accuracy, better
potential outcomes, and continuous progress in the fight against cancer.
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Putting big ideas into action

Discover our DNA through our latest announcements and stories.
[Colorectal cancer survivors uniting at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences.]

## The Power in Numbers

Colorectal cancer survivors unite at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences to celebrate their
triumphs, build community

## Become part of something meaningful

Changing lives and achieving our purpose starts with our team and their commitment to fighting
cancer. Are you ready to make a difference? Explore open positions and learn why Exact Sciences has
been a certified Great Place To Work^{®} for seven years running
[Three Exact Sciences' associates collaborating in the Wisconsin headquarters' atrium.]
[An Exact Sciences associate writing on a white board while her colleagues look on.]
[An Exact Sciences customer representative smiling and talking on a phone headset.]

## Get in touch

Questions or comments? Find customer support, company contacts, and location information all in one
place.

## Footnotes
1. In addition to being an Oncotype DX^{®} Ambassador, Deepa occasionally serves in a professional
   capacity as a paid consultant of Exact Sciences. These services are unrelated to this activity.
1. Diergaarde B, Young G, Hall DW, et al. Circulating tumor DNA as a marker of recurrence risk in
   stage III colorectal cancer: the α-CORRECT study. *J Surg Oncol*. Jan 2025. (Suppl). doi:
   10.1002/jso.27989

# Exact Sciences

[Woman relaxing at sunset.]
Introducing

## Cancerguard^{®}

Our innovative multi-cancer early detection test.
We're united by a shared purpose: helping people live fuller lives through better health. Together,
we will transform the way cancer is detected, diagnosed and managed for more people around the
world.
[Exact Sciences is now ABBOTT.]
[Lab technician examining a test sample on a microscope slide.]
We’re fighting cancer every step of the way
[A smiling patient hugging a caregiver.]
So that everyone feels confident about their path forward

## ## We help bring clarity to cancer

Cancer creates so many uncertainties. We’re committed to answering questions, solving problems, and
making a lasting, positive impact on people's lives. Our tests explore hereditary risks, screen for
cancer’s presence, and examine the unique genomic alterations of an individual’s cancer after a
diagnosis to help guide their treatment.

## Everything starts with people

We’re focused on patients, providers, doctors, researchers, and caregivers. Our medical experts
partner with the industry’s best minds and collaborate with top institutions, advocacy partners, and
policymakers to help change lives and transform how the world approaches cancer.
[A woman named Deepa smiling.]

## A breast cancer surgeon's breast cancer journey

Hear how genomic testing helped Deepa and her doctor make an informed decision to forgo
chemotherapy.^{[*][15]}
[oncotype DX Breast Recurrence Score logo.]
[A woman named Leigh Anne smiling.]

## Convenient testing made early detection easy

Watch how testing at home helped Leigh Anne take the first step in diagnosing and treating her colon
cancer before it progressed.
[Cologuard by Exact Sciences logo.]
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Fueling breakthroughs in cancer care

Our experience and process set us apart. Life-changing science. Deep expertise. Strong
collaboration. State-of-the-art labs. Rigorous research. The result? Proven accuracy, better
potential outcomes, and continuous progress in the fight against cancer.
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Putting big ideas into action

Discover our DNA through our latest announcements and stories.
[Colorectal cancer survivors uniting at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences.]

## The Power in Numbers

Colorectal cancer survivors unite at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences to celebrate their
triumphs, build community

## Become part of something meaningful

Changing lives and achieving our purpose starts with our team and their commitment to fighting
cancer. Are you ready to make a difference? Explore open positions and learn why Exact Sciences has
been a certified Great Place To Work^{®} for seven years running
[Three Exact Sciences' associates collaborating in the Wisconsin headquarters' atrium.]
[An Exact Sciences associate writing on a white board while her colleagues look on.]
[An Exact Sciences customer representative smiling and talking on a phone headset.]

## Get in touch

Questions or comments? Find customer support, company contacts, and location information all in one
place.

## Footnotes
1. In addition to being an Oncotype DX^{®} Ambassador, Deepa occasionally serves in a professional
   capacity as a paid consultant of Exact Sciences. These services are unrelated to this activity.
1. Diergaarde B, Young G, Hall DW, et al. Circulating tumor DNA as a marker of recurrence risk in
   stage III colorectal cancer: the α-CORRECT study. *J Surg Oncol*. Jan 2025. (Suppl). doi:
   10.1002/jso.27989

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]
[Labcorp biopharma technician evaluating samples]

Labcorp OnDemand

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

[ Shop All Tests ][223]

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]
[Labcorp biopharma technician evaluating samples]

Labcorp OnDemand

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

Who we are

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

[Biopharma][240] [Applied Solutions][241] [Food Solutions][242]


# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

[Explore Careers][244]


## Conveniently find parts for your instrument and place orders with our new online store.

[Shop Now][245]

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

Our focus is enabling the most innovative discovery, measurement, and testing solutions across our
strategic growth platforms.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

# Welcome to Sonic Healthcare

Sonic Healthcare is one of the world’s leading healthcare providers, with a reputation for
excellence in laboratory medicine / pathology, radiology and primary care medical services, across
operations in Australasia, Europe and North America.

[Learn more about Sonic Healthcare][69]

## Sonic Healthcare

## Medical Leadership

At Sonic Healthcare, we understand and respect the practice of medicine. Our unique culture of
Medical Leadership, which describes our management philosophy of placing the wellbeing of our
patients above all other considerations, inspires our people to deliver superior healthcare outcomes
for both doctors and patients.

[ Learn more about Medical Leadership ][82]
[Sonic Healthcare pathologist standing behind microscope in a laboratory.]

## Our People

At Sonic Healthcare our diagnostic and clinical services are provided by more than 2,200
pathologists, radiologists and other clinicians, and approximately 18,000 employees in science-based
roles, including radiographers, sonographers, technicians and nurses, all of whom are led by highly
experienced medical personnel, from Board level through to the management of our local practices.

[ Learn more about Our People ][83]

sustainable electricity production.]

## Sustainability

Sonic Healthcare’s Sustainability Report profiles our ongoing commitment to our people, the
communities we serve and the environments in which we operate, all within the framework of good
corporate governance.

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision

* What defines a Primary Care Clinic?
  
  A Primary Care Clinic is a healthcare facility that serves as the initial point of contact for
  individuals seeking medical care. It focuses on providing comprehensive, continuous, and
  coordinated healthcare services, including preventive care, diagnosis, treatment of common
  illnesses, and management of chronic conditions. Primary Care Clinics are typically staffed by
  general practitioners, family physicians, internists, or pediatricians who offer primary medical
  care and serve as the central hub for patients' healthcare needs. They play a crucial role in
  promoting overall wellness, disease prevention, and early intervention.

nationwide due to our high quality guaranteed personalized care.  Our core values are passion,
caring, integrity, and commitment to excellence.  With your help, we create the best plan designed
just for you.  Our comprehensive preventative health plans are ideal for a wide range of conditions.
We provide care and prevention for most chronic disease such as diabetes, hypertension, woman’s
health, congestive heart failure, medical weight loss, etc.


We provide quick reliable STD testing and treatment, on site lab draw, and medical weight management
(Semiglutide). Clinic Klinic in Marietta Georgia is a community based multilingual clinic.

[Smiling Young Man]

All of the services offered at our healthcare clinic in Marietta, GA are designed from the ground up
to provide customized prevention and treatment for every patient. This, along with our large variety
of services across the medical field, sets us apart from the limited and one-size-fits-all services
that dominate the sector. We ensure that every patient not only receives treatment but also receives
treatment that is designed to help them get the best results possible.


Our large variety of services encompasses the vast majority of medical areas that impact a person’s
life the most, as well.

First, we offer the finest preventative care measures available. For example, many of our patients
come to us without any concerns at all to receive an STD screening. This includes screening for
Chlamydia, HIV/AIDs, genital herpes, Hepatitis types B and C, and every other STD affecting the
Marietta, GA population. These are standard, discrete, STD screenings to help prevent serious
illnesses and some of the health problems that can stem from infection.

 

However, most of our patients come to us when they do have at least a minor concern to worry about.
This is in relation to a few of our screening services and our weight management programs.

[Modern Doctors]

several forms of cancer, hypertension, diabetes, and more. It’s important that our clients come to
us as soon as they possibly can to be checked for these dangerous illnesses, and in the case of
cancer, regular screening is recommended for anyone who falls into a high-risk category. If you’re
not sure whether or not you fall into a high-risk category for cancer or any of the other diseases

become ill. However, our job doesn’t stop. For every disease and condition we’ve mentioned, we offer
comprehensive treatment services to help our patients overcome their challenges. This includes

conditions. The women who approach our clinic for women’s health services can rely on us to have a
dedicated team determined to provide reliable, customized, effective services that change their
lives for the better.

to understanding our patients’ needs, developing customized plans to provide for those needs, and

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

## What our customers are saying
* ### Knowing where to look
  
  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only
  trace was a small edit buried in their developer docs. ForesightIQ flagged it."

  "Crayon missed an entire Square ads campaign. ForesightIQ caught it — screenshots and all — and

  [Min Chi]

  "ForesightIQ isn't a rearview mirror. It shows me where companies are headed next."
  
  [Marco Burgarello]
  Marco BurgarelloGTM Leader, Nextiva

We monitor the hidden sources everyone misses plus integrate custom sources specific to your
industry.

* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story

Questions?

## We've got answers

How is Geviti different from my regular doctor?

Geviti is designed to complement your regular care with a deeper, more proactive view of your
health. We test 100+ biomarkers and pair you with a dedicated Longevity Specialist who turns those
results into a personalized protocol, including supplements, prescriptions when appropriate, and
ongoing adjustments.

What does the 100+ biomarker panel actually test?

The panel looks across hormones, metabolic health, inflammation, vitamins and minerals, liver
function, kidney function, and more. The goal is to give your care team a fuller picture of how your
body is functioning, then translate those results into a plan you can act on.

How soon will I notice a difference?

Many members begin noticing changes in energy, sleep, focus, or recovery within the first few
months. On the clinical side, 78% of members see meaningful biomarker improvement within 6 months,
and your care team continues to adjust your protocol based on how you respond.

Does insurance cover this?

Traditional insurance usually does not cover proactive health optimization, but HSA and FSA payments
are accepted on all plans. We also provide documentation for eligible expenses so reimbursement is
easier to submit.

Is there a long-term commitment?

No. There are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. You can cancel anytime, keep access
through the end of your billing period, and your health records remain available to you.

Is Geviti available in my state?

Geviti is available in 47 states and is not currently available in AK, RI, or HI. In supported
states, at-home blood draws are available in many major metro areas through our partner network, and
we will guide you to the best available option for your location.

Do I need my own doctor to get prescriptions?

No. Your Geviti care team includes licensed providers who can prescribe clinically appropriate
longevity-focused therapies, including HRT and longevity peptides, based on your labs, intake, and

# Golden is now part of *ComplyAdvantage.*

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

# Because Her** **Health is all about **Her**.

Concierge gynecology in Lakewood Ranch, FL — with expert care, unhurried visits, and faith-based
support.

[ SCHEDULE AN APPOINTMENT ][29]

**What is Her Health?**

Her Health is a boutique gynecology clinic offering personalized, patient-centered care in Lakewood
Ranch, FL.

**We do not accept insurance** — instead, we provide transparent pricing, longer visits, and more
time to listen.

You can choose a la carte services or join one of our concierge Membership Plans for extra access
and support. Our goal is simple: to give you expert gynecology in a calm, compassionate space where
you feel truly heard.

Have more questions? [Click here for FAQ.][30]

WHY CHOOSE HER HEALTH?

## Because every woman deserves a healthcare experience where they feel heard, understood, and
## empowered.

[personalized-care-icon]

Personalized Care

We tailor your care to your unique needs, not a one-size-fits-all model.

[supportive-environment-Icon.png]

Supportive Environment

We create a safe, judgment-free space where you feel heard.

[focus-on-wellness-icon]

Focus on Wellness

Our care is proactive — focused on prevention and long-term wellness.

[dedicated-to-your-well-being-icon]

Committed to Your Health

We walk with you through every stage of life, with compassion and clarity.

# Gynecology That Meets You Where You Are — At Every Stage of Life

Whether you’re due for your annual exam, managing symptoms, or exploring advanced treatment options,
Her Health offers compassionate, expert care — tailored to your stage of life.

**Preventive & Routine Care**

[• Annual Exams ][31]

[• Hormone Testing][32]

✧For optimization and wellness

**Symptoms & Concerns**

• [Consults][33] for :

Irregular Periods

PCOS, [Perimenopause, and Menopause][34]

Low Libido, Pain, or Discomfort

• Pelvic [Ultrasound][35]

✧When something doesn’t feel right and you want answers

**Procedures & Surgery**

• IUD & Nexplanon Insertion/Removal

• Colposcopy & Biopsy

• [In-Office Hysteroscopy][36]

• Minimally Invasive Surgery ([Hysterectomy][37])

✧For diagnostic evaluation or treatment options

[**Skin REJUVENATION**][38]** **

• Morpheus8: Promotes collagen remodeling to reduce wrinkles, improve texture, and refine pores.

Full face & neck

Periorbital (under eyes) only

Lower face only

Neck only

✧When you want to improve texture, tone, and/or wrinkles.

[**Vaginal rejuvEnation**][39]

• Vtone: Pelvic floor strength training for bladder leakage, decrease sensation with intercourse.

• FormaV, Morpheus8V: Promotes vulvar and vaginal tightening, vaginal lubrication, and normal pH
balance.

• Tone: Supports pelvic strength

✧Promotes and optimizes vulvar, vaginal, and bladder health

[**hormone replacement therapy**][40]

• Pellets

• Creams

• Patches

✧For optimization of hormones

✧✧Looking for ongoing support?

that goes beyond the visit.

[headshot-of-dr-eden-yelverton]

## Meet Dr. Eden Yelverton

BOARD-CERTIFIED OBSTETRICIAN AND GYNECOLOGIST AND FOUNDER OF HER HEALTH

Her Health was born out of a calling to create a space where women feel truly seen, heard, and cared
for — body, mind, and spirit.

My passion for gynecology stems from a deep appreciation for the female body and its natural
rhythms. I find joy in educating and guiding women through different life stages, addressing their
unique needs with compassion and expertise.  

At Her Health, we believe in building strong relationships with our patients, empowering them to
take control of their health and live their lives to the fullest.

HER HEALTH. HER JOURNEY.

# Because Her** **Health is all about **Her**.

Concierge gynecology in Lakewood Ranch, FL — with expert care, unhurried visits, and faith-based
support.

[ SCHEDULE AN APPOINTMENT ][29]

**What is Her Health?**

Her Health is a boutique gynecology clinic offering personalized, patient-centered care in Lakewood
Ranch, FL.

**We do not accept insurance** — instead, we provide transparent pricing, longer visits, and more
time to listen.

You can choose a la carte services or join one of our concierge Membership Plans for extra access
and support. Our goal is simple: to give you expert gynecology in a calm, compassionate space where
you feel truly heard.

Have more questions? [Click here for FAQ.][30]

WHY CHOOSE HER HEALTH?

## Because every woman deserves a healthcare experience where they feel heard, understood, and
## empowered.

[personalized-care-icon]

Personalized Care

We tailor your care to your unique needs, not a one-size-fits-all model.

[supportive-environment-Icon.png]

Supportive Environment

We create a safe, judgment-free space where you feel heard.

[focus-on-wellness-icon]

Focus on Wellness

Our care is proactive — focused on prevention and long-term wellness.

[dedicated-to-your-well-being-icon]

Committed to Your Health

We walk with you through every stage of life, with compassion and clarity.

# Gynecology That Meets You Where You Are — At Every Stage of Life

Whether you’re due for your annual exam, managing symptoms, or exploring advanced treatment options,
Her Health offers compassionate, expert care — tailored to your stage of life.

**Preventive & Routine Care**

[• Annual Exams ][31]

[• Hormone Testing][32]

✧For optimization and wellness

**Symptoms & Concerns**

• [Consults][33] for :

Irregular Periods

PCOS, [Perimenopause, and Menopause][34]

Low Libido, Pain, or Discomfort

• Pelvic [Ultrasound][35]

✧When something doesn’t feel right and you want answers

**Procedures & Surgery**

• IUD & Nexplanon Insertion/Removal

• Colposcopy & Biopsy

• [In-Office Hysteroscopy][36]

• Minimally Invasive Surgery ([Hysterectomy][37])

✧For diagnostic evaluation or treatment options

[**Skin REJUVENATION**][38]** **

• Morpheus8: Promotes collagen remodeling to reduce wrinkles, improve texture, and refine pores.

Full face & neck

Periorbital (under eyes) only

Lower face only

Neck only

✧When you want to improve texture, tone, and/or wrinkles.

[**Vaginal rejuvEnation**][39]

• Vtone: Pelvic floor strength training for bladder leakage, decrease sensation with intercourse.

• FormaV, Morpheus8V: Promotes vulvar and vaginal tightening, vaginal lubrication, and normal pH
balance.

• Tone: Supports pelvic strength

✧Promotes and optimizes vulvar, vaginal, and bladder health

[**hormone replacement therapy**][40]

• Pellets

• Creams

• Patches

✧For optimization of hormones

✧✧Looking for ongoing support?

Explore our [Concierge Memberships][41] for more access, better continuity, and personalized care
that goes beyond the visit.

[ Learn about memberships ][42]

### [Vaginal & Skin Rejuvenation][43]

[headshot-of-dr-eden-yelverton]

## Meet Dr. Eden Yelverton

BOARD-CERTIFIED OBSTETRICIAN AND GYNECOLOGIST AND FOUNDER OF HER HEALTH

Her Health was born out of a calling to create a space where women feel truly seen, heard, and cared
for — body, mind, and spirit.

My passion for gynecology stems from a deep appreciation for the female body and its natural
rhythms. I find joy in educating and guiding women through different life stages, addressing their
unique needs with compassion and expertise.  

At Her Health, we believe in building strong relationships with our patients, empowering them to
take control of their health and live their lives to the fullest.

[ MORE ABOUT DR. YELVERTON ][44]

# What Women Are Saying

[women-diversity-extreme-closeup]

Thank you!

## Empowering Researchers Worldwide

IJARIIE is a leading international journal that provides a platform for researchers, academicians,
and practitioners to share their knowledge and innovative ideas. We are committed to publishing
high-quality research that contributes to the advancement of science and technology.

Our rigorous peer-review process ensures that only the best work is published, while our open-access
policy ensures that it reaches the widest possible audience. Whether you are a student, a professor,
or an industry professional, IJARIIE is the perfect place to publish your work.

### Easy Submission

Submit your research papers online with our simple and intuitive submission process. User-friendly
dashboard for tracking.

### Fast Peer Review

Get your papers reviewed quickly by our expert editorial board with a transparent and rigorous peer
review process.

### Quality Publication

Publish in a reputed journal with ISSN 2395-4396 and international recognition. Indexed in major
databases.

### Open Access

All published papers are freely available for download and citation, increasing the visibility of
your work.

[**San Mateo, CA**][137]

almost an instantaneous response.”

## WE BELIEVE THAT TECH EDUCATION IS FOR EVERYONE!

## **Unlock Your Potential with Accredited Online Training Courses**

Staying ahead in today’s fast-paced and highly competitive world requires more than just talent—it
requires continuous learning and professional growth. That’s why we’re committed to helping
individuals and organizations succeed through **Professional Training** programs designed for
real-world results.

Whether you're just starting your career or seeking to level up your current skills, our platform
offers a comprehensive range of **Accredited Online Training Courses** tailored to your goals. From
technical studies and business management to IT skills and software development, we deliver
world-class learning experiences at your fingertips. Our training partners are Top Tier including:
Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Cisco, Cambridge, NPTEL amongst others.

### 🎯 **Why Choose Our Online Professional Training Platform?**

Our vision is simple: to empower learners through **flexible, high-quality, and industry-relevant
training**. We understand that every learner is different, which is why we offer self-paced,
instructor-led, and hybrid formats that adapt to your schedule and learning style.

Our catalog of **Professional Development Courses Online** is designed by industry experts,
certified trainers, and thought leaders across various fields. Each course is built to equip you
with in-demand skills that employers value most in today's dynamic marketplace.

Whether you're a student, job seeker, entrepreneur, or working professional, we have a course that
fits your path to success.

We are committed to bridging the gap between education and employability. Our programs combine
practical, industry-driven learning with international accreditation, making our certifications
relevant across borders.
* Relevant skills education focused
* Internationally accredited certifications (ACTD-US & QAHE-UK)
* Flexible online learning programs
* Career-focused curriculum designed for today’s workforce
* Trainers from multiple countries and industries


### 🎓 **Explore Our Certificate Courses Online**

Earn recognized credentials that showcase your skills and commitment to continuous improvement. Our
**Certificate Courses Online** are not only accessible from anywhere in the world but are also
aligned with global standards and frameworks. Each certificate adds credibility to your resume and
opens doors to new opportunities across industries such as:
* Information Technology & Cybersecurity
* Digital Marketing & eCommerce
* Business Management & Leadership
* Data Analysis & Artificial Intelligence
* Human Resources & Project Management
* Software, IT & Programming

By enrolling in our certificate programs, you gain more than just knowledge—you gain an edge in the
job market.

### 📈 **Advance Your Career with Professional Development Courses Online**

Our **Professional Development Courses Online** are strategically designed to meet the evolving
needs of both individuals and organizations. Whether you're looking to upskill in your current role,

# Women's health and genetic testing

We aspire to be the lab that supports women's needs wherever they are in their lives, whatever their
health and personal situation, wherever they go for their testing and whomever they see.

[Black multi-generation family blowing bubbles outdoors]

### [For Patients][124]

**Advancing Health for All**

Everyone has different healthcare needs throughout their life. One of the ways that you can be
proactive about your health is by learning about testing and screening that can help you be as
healthy as possible. With our decades of commitment to women's health, we are here for you.

 

[ Patient Services][125]
[Medical team in discussion in hospital corridor]

### [For Providers][126]

**Advancing Women’s Health**

Whether supporting your patient's pregnancy, offering insights to help understand issues related to
infertility or helping women live healthier lives, we provide an industry-leading portfolio of tests
combined with the excellent support, services and ease-of-use you can rely on.

 

[ Provider Services][127]

# Women's health and genetic testing

We aspire to be the lab that supports women's needs wherever they are in their lives, whatever their
health and personal situation, wherever they go for their testing and whomever they see.

[Black multi-generation family blowing bubbles outdoors]

### [For Patients][124]

**Advancing Health for All**

Everyone has different healthcare needs throughout their life. One of the ways that you can be
proactive about your health is by learning about testing and screening that can help you be as
healthy as possible. With our decades of commitment to women's health, we are here for you.

 

[ Patient Services][125]
[Medical team in discussion in hospital corridor]

### [For Providers][126]

**Advancing Women’s Health**

Whether supporting your patient's pregnancy, offering insights to help understand issues related to
infertility or helping women live healthier lives, we provide an industry-leading portfolio of tests
combined with the excellent support, services and ease-of-use you can rely on.

 

[ Provider Services][127]

## Welcome to Labcorp Women’s Health and Genetics

and parenting journey.

# Best Multi-Speciality Hospital in Hyderabad

From the last three decades, Yashoda Group of Hospitals has been providing quality healthcare for
the people in their diverse medical needs. People trust us because of the strong relationships we’ve
built with them over the years.

Under astute leadership and strong management, Yashoda Group of Hospitals has evolved as a centre of
excellence in medicine providing the highest quality standards of medical treatment to all sections
of the society. Our work has always been guided by the needs of patients and delivered by our
perfectly combined revolutionary technology, best medical expertise and advanced procedures.
